def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    board = state_view.board
    other = 1 - player_id
    own = board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6]
    opp = board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6]
    lead = state_view.captured[player_id] - state_view.captured[other]
    total = state_view.total_seeds
    concentration = max(own) - max(opp)
    score = 0.7 * lead + 0.25 * (sum(own) - sum(opp)) / (1 + total) + 0.2 * concentration / (1 + total)
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, score))

def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    board = state_view.board
    other = 1 - player_id
    own = board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6]
    opp = board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6]
    lead = state_view.captured[player_id] - state_view.captured[other]
    seed_diff = sum(own) - sum(opp)
    own_spread = max(own) - min(own)
    opp_spread = max(opp) - min(opp)
    total = state_view.total_seeds
    score = 0.65 * lead + 0.2 * seed_diff / (1 + total) - 0.15 * (own_spread - opp_spread) / (1 + total)
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, score))
